001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropMask extends Propagator<SetVar> {
017
018    private final SetVar set;
019    private final SetVar masked;
020    private final ISetDeltaMonitor setD;
021    private final ISetDeltaMonitor maskedD;
022    // Inclusive
023    private final int from;
024    // Exclusive
025    private final int to;
026
027    public PropMask(SetVar set, SetVar masked, int from, int to) {
028        super(new SetVar[]{set, masked}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, true);
029
030        if (from > to) {
031            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
032        }
033
034        this.set = set;
035        this.masked = masked;
036        this.setD = set.monitorDelta(this);
037        this.maskedD = masked.monitorDelta(this);
038        this.from = from;
039        this.to = to;
040    }
041
042    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
043        return idx == 0;
044    }
045
046    private boolean isMaskedVar(int idx) {
047        return idx == 1;
048    }
049
050    @Override
051    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
052        return SetEventType.all();
053    }
054
055    @Override
056    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
057        ISetIterator setKer = set.getLB().iterator();
058        while (setKer.hasNext()) {
059            int i = setKer.nextInt();
060            if (i >= from && i < to) {
061                masked.force(i - from, this);
062            }
063        }
064        ISetIterator setEnv = set.getUB().iterator();
065        while (setEnv.hasNext()) {
066            int i = setEnv.nextInt();
067            if (i >= from && i < to && !masked.getUB().contains(i - from)) {
068                set.remove(i, this);
069            }
070        }
071        ISetIterator maskedKer = masked.getLB().iterator();
072        while (maskedKer.hasNext()) {
073            int i = maskedKer.nextInt();
074            set.force(i + from, this);
075        }
076        ISetIterator maskedEnv = masked.getUB().iterator();
077        while (maskedEnv.hasNext()) {
078            int i = maskedEnv.nextInt();
079            if (i < 0 || i >= to - from || !set.getUB().contains(i + from)) {
080                masked.remove(i, this);
081            }
082        }
083        setD.startMonitoring();
084        maskedD.startMonitoring();
085    }
086
087    @Override
088    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
089        if (isSetVar(idxVarInProp)) {
090            setD.forEach(this::pickMaskedOnSetKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
091            setD.forEach(this::pruneMaskedOnSetEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
092        } else {
093            assert isMaskedVar(idxVarInProp);
094            maskedD.forEach(this::pickSetOnMaskedKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
095            maskedD.forEach(this::pruneSetOnMaskedEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
096        }
097    }
098
099    private void pickMaskedOnSetKer(int ker) throws ContradictionException {
100        if (ker >= from && ker < to) {
101            masked.force(ker - from, this);
102        }
103    }
104
105    private void pruneMaskedOnSetEnv(int env) throws ContradictionException {
106        if (env >= from && env < to) {
107            masked.remove(env - from, this);
108        }
109    }
110
111    private void pickSetOnMaskedKer(int ker) throws ContradictionException {
112        assert ker < to - from;
113        set.force(ker + from, this);
114    }
115
116    private void pruneSetOnMaskedEnv(int env) throws ContradictionException {
117        assert env < to - from;
118        set.remove(env + from, this);
119    }
120
121    @Override
122    public ESat isEntailed() {
123        ISetIterator setKer = set.getLB().iterator();
124        while (setKer.hasNext()) {
125            int i = setKer.nextInt();
126            if (i >= from && i < to && !masked.getUB().contains(i - from)) {
127                return ESat.FALSE;
128            }
129        }
130        ISetIterator maskedKer = masked.getLB().iterator();
131        while (maskedKer.hasNext()) {
132            int i = maskedKer.nextInt();
133            if (i < 0 || i >= to - from || !set.getUB().contains(i + from)) {
134                return ESat.FALSE;
135            }
136        }
137        return set.isInstantiated() && masked.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
138    }
139
140    @Override
141    public String toString() {
142        return "mask(" + set + ", " + masked + ", " + from + ", " + to + ")";
143    }
144}
